facts.raw_span: a 2-month history of postprandial abdominal pain
nausea, night sweats, early satiety, and a 10-kg weight loss
distal ileitis
he had received a course of antibiotics without improvement
he denied hematochezia, diarrhea, or fevers
he was afebrile with stable vital signs
no abdominal tenderness or palpable masses, and no evidence of perianal disease
an erythrocyte sedimentation rate of 42 mm/hr
a C-reactive protein level of 35 mg/L
a fecal calprotectin of 94 μg/mg
Stool studies were negative for enteric pathogens
QuantiFERON-TB Gold was positive

concepts.why: The patient's symptoms of postprandial abdominal pain, nausea, and weight loss, along with the finding of distal ileitis and elevated inflammatory markers, are consistent with Crohn's disease.
The patient's positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold test and symptoms of abdominal pain and weight loss, along with the finding of distal ileitis, are consistent with intestinal tuberculosis.
The patient's symptoms of abdominal pain, nausea, and weight loss, along with the finding of cecal ulcers and elevated inflammatory markers, are consistent with ulcerative colitis.
The patient's positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold test is consistent with latent tuberculosis.
The patient's symptoms of abdominal pain and weight loss, along with the finding of distal ileitis and elevated inflammatory markers, are consistent with ileocecal inflammation.
The patient's symptoms of abdominal pain, nausea, and weight loss, along with the finding of elevated inflammatory markers, are consistent with inflammatory bowel disease.
The patient's positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold test and symptoms of abdominal pain and weight loss, along with the finding of distal ileitis, are consistent with gastrointestinal tuberculosis.
The patient's symptoms of abdominal pain and weight loss, along with the finding of distal ileitis and elevated inflammatory markers, are consistent with chronic ileitis.
The patient's symptoms of abdominal pain and weight loss, along with the finding of cecal ulcers and elevated inflammatory markers, are consistent with colonic inflammation.
The patient's finding of a nontraversable distal ileal stricture is consistent with ileal stricture.

rationales.F01: Postprandial abdominal pain is a common symptom of Crohn's disease and ileocecal inflammation.
rationales.F03: Distal ileitis is a characteristic feature of Crohn's disease and intestinal tuberculosis.
rationales.F10: Elevated fecal calprotectin is a marker of intestinal inflammation, which is common in Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
rationales.F12: A positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold test is highly suggestive of latent tuberculosis or gastrointestinal tuberculosis.

frontier_selector.rationale: QuantiFERON-TB Gold was positive and the patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with intestinal tuberculosis, making it a more specific diagnosis than Crohn's disease.
